description:
Actors: spawn, find, move, attach, hide, inspect and destroy actors in the running world. Spawned actors become
scene-graph nodes (ids like "n12") that every other toolset accepts; level actors are addressed as actor:Name.
Workflow: find_actors (or spawn_actor) -> set_transform / attach / set_visibility -> list_components to reach a
component's properties with reflection tools. Use the scene toolset to organise nodes into groups.
name: actors

tools.description:
Adds any engine component to an actor and sets its properties: movement (ProjectileMovementComponent, RotatingMovementComponent, InterpToMovementComponent), shapes and triggers (SphereComponent, BoxComponent, CapsuleComponent), lights (PointLightComponent, SpotLightComponent), AudioComponent, PhysicsConstraintComponent, PhysicsThrusterComponent, RadialForceComponent... Scene components attach to the root (or attach_to) at location. Change it later with reflection.set_properties / call_function on the returned ref.
Returns: The new component. Fails if the class is unknown, abstract or not a component, or a property does not apply.

attach_to.description: Name of the scene component to attach to (default: the root).

class.description: Component class name, e.g. "RotatingMovementComponent" (the U prefix is optional).

location.description: Relative location of a scene component. ([x, y, z] (cm))

properties.description: Property values, e.g. {"RotationRate": {"Yaw": 90}} or {"InitialSpeed": 1200, "ProjectileGravityScale": 0}. (Any JSON value)

target.description: Actor or node id, e.g. "n12". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.add_component

returnValue.description: The new component. Fails if the class is unknown, abstract or not a component, or a property does not apply.

parent.description: Name of the scene component it is attached to (empty for the root and non-scene components).

ref.description: Component address ("n12#StaticMeshComponent0"): pass it as `target` to reflection tools or as a component argument.

visible.description: Scene components: visible flag (true for non-scene components).

returnValue.title: RuntimeComponentInfo

tools.description:
Attaches an actor to another actor, or detaches it when parent is omitted. Undoable. For tool-created nodes this also moves the node in the scene graph. Fails if the parent is the child or attached below it.
Returns: Child and new parent references.

child.description: Actor to attach. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

keep_world.description: Keep the world transform (false keeps the relative transform).

parent.description: New parent actor; omit (or "") to detach. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

socket.description: Socket or bone name on the parent's root component, e.g. "hand_r".

tools.name: actors.attach

parent.description: The new parent, empty when detached.

tools.description:
Deletes an actor and its node subtree. Undoable (the actors are hidden until the step leaves history). Fails for level actors unless the project allows it (bAllowDestroyLevelActors); hide them with set_visibility instead.
Returns: References of the deleted actors.

target.description: Actor to delete, e.g. "n12" or "actor:PointLight_0". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.destroy_actor

deleted.description: References of the deleted actors (the target and its node subtree).

tools.description:
Searches the world for actors by name, class, tag, subtree and bounds (Epic's scene.find_actors).
Returns: Total match count and the actors {ref, name, class, location, rotation, tags, hidden}, in world order.

bounds.description: Only actors whose bounds overlap this world box {min:[x,y,z], max:[x,y,z]}.
bounds.title: RuntimeBox

class.description: Class name wildcard, matched against the class and its parents, e.g. "*Light*" or "StaticMeshActor".

collision_channels.description: With bounds: use a physics overlap restricted to these object channels (e.g. ["ECC_WorldStatic", "ECC_PhysicsBody"]); actors without collision are then ignored.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden level actors (hidden tool-created nodes are always included).

name.description: Name filter: a wildcard ("Light*") or a case-insensitive substring of the actor or node name.

root.description: Only this actor and the actors attached below it. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.find_actors

returnValue.description: Total match count and the actors {ref, name, class, location, rotation, tags, hidden}, in world order.

actors.description: Matches in world iteration order, at most `limit`.

name.description: Node name for tool-created actors, else the engine object name.

ref.description: Reference to pass to other tools: node id for tool-created actors, else actor:Name.

total.description: Number of matching actors (may exceed the returned list).

truncated.description: True when more actors matched than were returned.

returnValue.title: RuntimeActorList

tools.description:
Lists an actor's components. Each ref ("n12#LightComponent0") can be passed directly as a target to reflection tools (list_properties, set_properties, call_function) or to any tool that takes a component.
Returns: The actor reference, total count and components {ref, name, class, parent, root, visible}.

class.description: Only components of this class (wildcard, parents included), e.g. "*Light*".

target.description: Actor to inspect. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.list_components

returnValue.description: The actor reference, total count and components {ref, name, class, parent, root, visible}.

components.description: Components in the actor's order, at most `limit`.

parent.description: Name of the scene component it is attached to (empty for the root and non-scene components).

ref.description: Component address ("n12#StaticMeshComponent0"): pass it as `target` to reflection tools or as a component argument.

visible.description: Scene components: visible flag (true for non-scene components).

total.description: Number of matching components (may exceed the list).

returnValue.title: RuntimeComponentList

tools.description:
Removes a component (not the root).
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.

target.description: Component ref "actor#Component", e.g. "n12#RotatingMovement". Fails if it is the actor's root component. (Reference to ActorComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.remove_component

tools.description:
Sets an actor's location, rotation and/or scale; parts you omit stay unchanged and attached children follow. Undoable.
Returns: The actor's resulting world transform.

location.description: [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

rotation.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

space.description: World, or Relative to the attach parent.

target.description: Actor to move. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: actors.set_transform

target.description: The changed actor (node id or actor:Name).

warning.description: Set when the change has a side effect worth knowing (e.g. shearing children).

tools.description:
Shows or hides an actor in game (and, by default, the actors attached to it). Undoable.
Returns: The target, the new visibility and how many actors changed.

target.description: Actor to show or hide. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

visible.description: True to show, false to hide.

tools.name: actors.set_visibility

returnValue.description: The target, the new visibility and how many actors changed.

actors.description: Actors changed (the target plus attached actors when propagating).

returnValue.title: RuntimeVisibilityResult

tools.description:
Spawns a basic shape or an actor class as a new scene node. Undoable. With a parent the transform is relative to it. Fails if both or neither of shape and class are given, the shape is unknown, or the class is missing or not allowed.
Returns: The new node: {id, name, path, actor}.

class.description: Actor class path instead of a shape, e.g. "/Script/Engine.PointLight" or "/Game/BP_Door".

color.description: Shape color [r, g, b] 0-1, e.g. [1, 0.2, 0.1]. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

location.description: [x, y, z] in cm (default origin). ([x, y, z] (cm))

name.description: Node name (made unique among siblings), e.g. "crate". Defaults to the shape or class name.

parent.description: Parent node; the transform is then relative to it. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

properties.description: Class only: property values set before the actor is constructed, so Blueprints that build themselves in their construction script (roads, fences, generators) build from them, e.g. {"Spawn Spline Points": [[0,0,0],[5000,0,0]], "Sidewalk R": true}. Names as reflection lists them. (Any JSON value)

rotation.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

shape.description: Basic 100 cm shape: cube, sphere, cylinder, cone or plane.

tools.name: actors.spawn_actor

returnValue.description: The new node: {id, name, path, actor}.

actor.description: Engine object name of the actor (for actor:Name references).

id.description: Node id, e.g. "n12". Pass it to any tool that takes an actor or a node.

name.description: Node name, unique among its siblings.

path.description: Path through node names from the root, e.g. "house/door" (also accepted wherever a node is expected).

returnValue.title: RuntimeNodeInfo
